 GeniosAI, which develops AI software for financial analysis and modeling, raised $19.1M across seed and Series A rounds; FactSet led the Series A   —  GeniosAI, which develops AI software for financial analysis and modeling, has raised $19.1 million in combined seed and Series A funding, CEO PD Singh tells Axios Pro exclusively.
